searchText: That's correct we only implement the local key manager part of the API at the moment this is in the README btw: <https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs#v1-apis> we could maybe add some tags/categories to make it clearer (and so it shows up on the API spec page) ah nice, thanks <@602753420033785856> ! Requires access to a beacon node" Updated PR again, thanks all! btw <@340345049063882753> glad to see you here ☺️ Oh yeah, I'm still keeping my eye on you all. 😛 this bit I added comments on.... - no reason to say that for exits, and im not sure that the PR should be held up on arguments over updating unrelated tag descriptions... Thanks <@680234424037670912> I've reverted that commit - I'll create a separate PR for the tag discussion 🙂
